image_title: Comparison of Template-based and LLM-based Responses
summary: This bar chart compares responses to various questions using Template-based and LLM-based methods, measured on a Likert scale from 1 to 7. The questions assess the impact of asking questions on goal selection, plan improvement, difficulty reduction, and overall satisfaction. Notable p-values indicate statistical significance, with questions about plan improvement and difficulty reduction showing significant differences (p-values of 0.01 and 0.02, respectively). The chart highlights differences in response patterns between the two methods, with Template-based responses generally showing more variability.
